Count the bytes without building the String: `self.text.len() + self.children.iter().map(|child| match child { InlineSpan::Text(span) => span.text_len(), InlineSpan::Widget(_) => '\u{fffc}'.len_utf8() }).sum::<usize>()`. This matches plain_text(), which appends each widget as U+FFFC.
